# Ninai

Ninai gives Claude Code and Codex shared project memory on Mac while the user controls what each assistant may receive. Hosted storage is planned for later and is not available today.

## Canonical pages
- Home: https://ninai.io/
- Install: https://ninai.io/install/
- Local engine: https://ninai.io/local/
- Privacy: https://ninai.io/privacy/

## Core product facts
- Ninai stores the complete memory in a local SQLite database.
- Supported assistants connect through a local tool interface.
- Each assistant receives only the memory areas the user allows.
- Returned context includes its source and a bounded amount of text.
- The complete memory stays local, but selected context is sent to the chosen AI provider.
- Automatic capture currently targets Claude Code PostToolUse hooks.
- Hosted Claude/Codex onboarding is invitation-only and operator-assisted.
- Connecting Ninai does not give it silent access to unrelated ChatGPT or Claude conversations.
- Local memory is never uploaded or synchronized automatically.
- Ninai has not completed an independent security audit and does not yet ship a signed desktop package.
